usageNotes: Use this to permanently remove a user account from the PDM configuration. Requires the `Access.Modify` privilege on `/access/users`, or the user may self-delete. Pass the `digest` parameter (obtained from the corresponding GET) to guard against concurrent modifications overwriting an unseen change.

examples.summary: Delete a local PDM user account

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the user account from the PDM configuration; all associated tokens and permissions granted to that user are also lost.
tips: The userid format must match `<name>@<realm>` (e.g., `admin@pdc`); the pattern enforces this.
Supplying `digest` prevents silent overwrites when another operator modifies the user list concurrently — always fetch it from a prior GET /access/users/{userid} call.
This operation returns null on success; any non-2xx response indicates failure.
